CHANGE
Rounded 48dp project selector with an independent CHEVRON_DOWN vector and
END-ellipsized name. Chooser rows distinguish date, photo count, selection
check and active reception status. The durable project/original format and
camera protocol implementation are unchanged by this patch.

CHECKS
249 store checks pass against the final production classes. Durable-store
source protections were audited. This is not a new full core/probe/server,
protocol, background, Doze or physical-camera validation run.

FINAL APK EMULATOR
Android 17 / Pixel 9. The older 0.7.0 APK created two projects:
- AutumnPortraitSessionAtTheLakesideAndOldTown2026: two synthetic photos 4/5.
- Weekend: empty.
Stopped reception and disconnected before preserve-data upgrade to 0.7.1.
Both projects/photos remain and switch offline. Force-stop/cold-start keeps
the long-name selected project ID and its two photos. Weekend still shows
the correct empty state, and reopening the chooser retains both projects.
Light/dark selector and menu screenshots were inspected as legible.
Installed emulator base APK SHA-256 matches the final artifact. App services
are empty. App-package/FATAL EXCEPTION crash filter is empty; vendor UWB
service failures are unrelated. run-as is unavailable because the package
is non-debuggable; no private Android disk inspection is claimed.
